name: CAGR calculator
summary: Compound annual growth rate from a start value, end value, and year count.
author: friday-core
description: Informational analysis, education, or calculation only. FRIDAY has no brokerage or exchange connection and cannot place, execute, or automate a real trade. CAGR = (end/start)^(1/years) − 1. Backward-looking math on numbers you type; not a forecast service.
